target.title: Deploy verifies build and sandbox
target.test: The final deploy path must build the monorepo, run the policy test hook, refresh Docker compose, verify sandbox write, and tear down compose.

steps.expected: The deploy command completes successfully and its output includes Turbo build execution, Docker compose down, compose build, compose up, sandbox write verification, and final compose down.

target.passCriteria: npm run deploy completes the full repository verification contract.

target.expected: The deploy command completes successfully and its output includes Turbo build execution, Docker compose down, compose build, compose up, sandbox write verification, and final compose down.

steps.descript: The full deploy command completed the build, policy hook, compose refresh, sandbox write, and teardown.
evidence: Deploy output included turbo 2.9.9 with 4 successful build tasks.
Deploy output included agenttest policy hook: strict JSON results under test/YYYYMMDD.
Deploy output built docker.io/hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 from apps/toolcontainer.
Deploy output created, started, stopped, removed ndx-ndx-sandbox-1, then removed ndx_default network.

result.descript: npm run deploy satisfies the repository verification contract.
